name: Wartenberg Syndrome / Superficial Radial Neuropathy
definition: Entrapment or irritation of the superficial radial sensory nerve causing dorsoradial hand numbness, burning or pain without motor weakness.

core: Motor exam to exclude radial palsy

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is mainly clinical; electrodiagnostics or ultrasound are selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent focal entrapment may require specialist evaluation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hasta/Vata neuralgic phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Entrapment or irritation of the superficial radial sensory nerve causing dorsoradial hand numbness, burning or pain without motor weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
